scope: Oracle bounded ordinary workload screening, three rounds, not formal M6/router qualification
rule: No retries or discarded observations. Count behavior failures even when runner marks invalid. Cost signal: >10% median increase, exceeding both range/median dispersions, and all 3 paired directions higher. No signal does not establish equivalence. Skips or generator limits restrict interpretation.
measurement: 5s warmup + 15s measured + barrier then 0/1/5s drain; cgroup CPU includes TCP descendants; 1Hz sampled memory peaks, PSS primary; C barrier only checks no children, Rust also returns to idle FD count; reload is one-line hosts plus 10 TFTP transfers/s, period5s; no saturation
